settings_notes: Uniform protocol arm only (§2.5): minimum reasoning/thinking settings across the roster; an as-deployed arm starts with the first multi-vendor wave.
Temperature is not exposed by the Claude Code subagent harness; this is disclosed deviation (2) of METHODOLOGY §7 and recorded here rather than hidden behind a nominal value.
The platform's own system prompt is vendor-controlled and not publishable — disclosed limitation, METHODOLOGY §7 deviation (1); full harness prompt texts and raw outputs are published verbatim.
Pilot seed is commit-hash-derived (§6, §7 deviation (3)); beacon seeding starts Wave 1.
P0 results are quarantined per METHODOLOGY §7: methodology validation only, never citable as a finding about Claude or about AI.
